This folder contains the unmodified, separately licensed ONLYOFFICE plugin SDK,
used inside the Euro-Office plugin iframe. It is served locally; opening a file
does not contact the SDK publisher.

- Source: https://onlyoffice.github.io/sdkjs-plugins/v1/plugins.js
- Retrieved: 2026-11-19
- SHA-256: `ae69fdbb8133ee8ee0df509788167a6ab5d1f6b0eeae1eb8a6f8c627bf79d3c1`
- License: AGPL-3.0, with the additional terms retained in the source header.
  See `LICENSE.txt` and the header of `plugins.js`.

EERP's plugin code is in the parent directory. The SDK is not bundled into the
EERP application or imported by its frontend packages.
